name: ComicIdeas
tagline: One sentence to a finished AI comic
description:
AI comic book maker: free scripts (10/day), consistent characters, editable bubbles. Pay per panel. Export PNG/PDF/CBZ.
ComicIdeas is an AI comic book maker that turns a single sentence into a finished comic. Start with free scripts—up to ten per day—then generate story panels with consistent characters using character sheets. Pick from about twenty art styles, including manga, webtoon, Ghibli-inspired looks, and kids storybook. Speech bubbles are editable vectors, so you can refine dialogue without redrawing. When you are done, export PNG, PDF, or CBZ for reading or publishing. Pricing is freemium: new accounts receive 100 welcome credits, and you pay only for the panels you generate. Visit comicideas.com to try it.
